description: Pods system: Pod listing, pod detail with compatibility scores, member list, shared meeting time, pod generation using matching algorithm, join/leave actions, and pod group chat integration.
steps: Create src/app/(main)/pods/page.tsx - Pods listing page showing: recommended pods sorted by compatibility score, each pod card shows title, type badge (study/project/career/interest/event/major_switch), member avatars (3-5), compatibility score, primary shared class/goal, suggested meeting time, Join button. Include tabs or filter for pod types. Empty state for no pods.

Create src/components/pods/pod-card.tsx - Pod card component with title, type badge (color-coded by type), member avatar stack, compatibility score badge, explanation snippet, meeting time, action button (Join/Joined/Leave).
Create src/components/pods/pod-type-badge.tsx - Color-coded badge for pod type (study=blue, project=purple, career=green, interest=orange, event=teal, major_switch=indigo).

Create src/app/(main)/pods/[id]/page.tsx - Pod detail page showing: pod title and type, full compatibility explanation using generatePodExplanation, all members with their avatars/names/majors, shared class or goal details, suggested meeting time with availability overlap visual (using findBestMeetingTime), pod score breakdown (shared_class_or_goal 30, availability_overlap 25, study_style_fit 15, interest_overlap 15, skill_balance 15), 'Open Group Chat' button, Join/Leave button.
Create src/components/pods/pod-members-list.tsx - List of pod members showing avatar, name, major, and their individual contribution to the pod (e.g., 'shares CS 46A', 'available evenings').
Create src/components/pods/pod-meeting-time.tsx - Visual display of the suggested meeting time with day/time slot and overlap indicator showing when all members are free.
Create src/components/pods/pod-score-breakdown.tsx - Pod scoring breakdown similar to match breakdown but with pod-specific categories.
Wire up Join action: adds current user to pod members, adds them to pod conversation. Leave action: removes from pod and conversation with confirmation dialog.

Generate recommended pods for current user using the generatePods function from lib/matching/pods.ts. In mock mode, use the pre-seeded 5 pods plus dynamically suggest new pods based on the current user's classes and interests.
Handle edge cases: pod full (5 members max), user already in pod, user leaving last pod, empty pods state.
acceptance_criteria: Pods page lists recommended pods sorted by compatibility
Each pod card shows type, members, score, shared goal, and meeting time
Pod detail shows full explanation, all members, and score breakdown
Suggested meeting time is calculated from member availability overlap
Join button adds user to pod and its group chat
Leave button removes user with confirmation
Pod type badges are color-coded by type
Empty state renders when no pods available
findings: Pods system implemented with full localStorage persistence for join/leave state. Created pod-actions.ts and pod-scoring.ts in src/lib/data/ for pod membership and scoring utilities. The scoring reuses the same algorithm structure as lib/matching/pods.ts but adapted for scoring a single user against existing pod members. Pod conversations are integrated with the existing chat localStorage system (shares the same keys). The findBestMeetingTime utility from lib/matching/availability.ts works well for showing suggested times. Dashboard pod-preview-card updated to link to /pods/[id] detail page. All 52 tests pass. Build produces /pods as static and /pods/[id] as dynamic route.
